summary: Your own programs can read and change Entra Policy Suite settings by code, with security controls kept for people.

new.title: Manage settings by code
new.text: An application you approve can export and import settings through the API. Grants and tenant changes wait in the commit queue for a person. Sign-in, approval, audit and other security settings stay person-only.

new.title: Support fixes when you ask
new.text: If you ask Invardia to fix a support ticket for you, your administrator can switch on Support fixes. Each fix is a listed, safe step on a ticket, recorded in the audit trail and mailed to you.
